claims.text: All planning to or able to become preg: daily folic acid 0.4 to 0.8 mg (400 to 800 mcg).
claims.quote: all persons planning to or who could become pregnant take a daily supplement containing 0.4 to 0.8 mg (400 to 800 mcg) of folic acid

claims.text: Prior baby w a neural tube defect: higher doses (up to 4 mg/day).
claims.quote: higher daily doses (up to 4 mg) are recommended for women who have had a baby with a neural tube defect
